6 Mar 2025
Claim reported by the claimant, who states they were a passenger in a vehicle struck from behind at a stop. The
claimant is not represented by a lawyer and has been advised of the claims process.
14 Mar 2025
Police attended the scene and their report confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision. Several
bystanders who stopped at the scene also confirm this.
18 Mar 2025
Photographs supplied by the policyholder show damage to the rear of the vehicle consistent with the reported impact.
No independent witnesses have come forward to describe the collision itself.
20 Mar 2025
The driver, who lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member, gave a statement that matches
the claimant's account of how the impact happened.
3 May 2025
The claimant reported shoulder pain on the day of the collision and was assessed at an urgent care clinic. The injury
described is consistent with the force and direction of the impact shown in the vehicle damage.
6 Jun 2025
An inspection of the vehicle found damage to the rear bumper, tailgate, and surrounding panels that matches the
described impact. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known to this office from its records.
19 Jun 2025
A repair estimate issued before the policy start date shows that damage of this same type and location already
existed on the vehicle. This conflicts with the other information gathered so far and is being reviewed with the
policyholder.
25 Jun 2025
Medical records received show the claimant has no prior treatment or complaints involving the same shoulder. No
earlier injury to that area is known.
11 Aug 2025
The claimant has described the collision the same way in each conversation, including the initial call, the recorded
statement, and a follow-up call. Details such as the speed and the sequence of events have stayed consistent.
18 Aug 2025
Treatment followed a typical course, with physiotherapy and medication over several weeks. The claimant's reported
pain has eased steadily as treatment progressed, and the treating provider has noted improvement.
16 Sep 2025
The treating provider has indicated that treatment is tapering off as the claimant recovers. The claimant has been
asked to provide any further records and to confirm whether symptoms have fully resolved.
29 Sep 2025

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
